subject: Private VPC staging handshake - network ownership clarifications
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@finledger.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Private VPC staging handshake - network ownership clarifications

Hi Alex —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick post-call recap and the handful of open items we promised to follow up on so you can share with NetOps/security: 

TL;DR: FinLedger prefers PrivateLink but we need confirmation on IP allowlist ownership, TLS termination point, and whether FinLedger will manage outbound NAT for the tenant. Once we have those answers we can finalize the SOW and schedule the staging cutover window.

Open items / asks (action owners in parentheses):
- Preferred connectivity mode: PrivateLink (you) — you mentioned a preference for PrivateLink but asked to confirm with NetOps/security.
- IP allowlist: provide list of source IP ranges your team will allow (Alex / FinLedger NetOps).
- Egress/NAT ownership: confirm whether FinLedger will provide static egress IPs for outbound traffic from the private connector, or if Redwood should expect to manage egress via our connector (FinLedger / Redwood ops).
- TLS & certs: confirm whether TLS termination happens at FinLedger's endpoint (recommended) or at Redwood (we can terminate if needed; requires mutual TLS option) (Ben/Redwood to confirm capabilities).
- Staging window: target two consecutive low-traffic nights for a short validation window; propose Fri 7/28 - Sat 7/29 (Marissa / Alex to confirm).

Attachments: network-diagram-v1.pdf (simple connectivity sketch), redwood-privatenet-sow-draft.docx (first pass SOW).

Next steps: could you share a short NetOps contact and the allowlist by EOD 7/15? If NetOps prefers a ticketing path, we can open a shared JIRA/Confluence thread.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@finledger.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: FinLedger Security <security@finledger.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC staging handshake - network ownership clarifications

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Short answers from NetOps/security POV: 

- Connectivity mode: FinLedger prefers PrivateLink for tenant isolation and auditing. We will confirm formally but this is our preference.
- IP allowlist: we'll provide a list of allowed source CIDRs for the PrivateLink endpoint. I can share a preliminary set by EOD — security may request an expanded justification doc.
- Egress/NAT: FinLedger operates centralized egress NAT for outbound flows. We'll expose static NAT IPs for the connectors, but that requires a short maintenance window to provision and test.
- TLS & certs: our security team prefers TLS termination on our side (FinLedger-managed), with mutual TLS as an option for higher sensitivity endpoints. Please confirm what cert formats and CA chains you accept.

I'll loop in Tom from NetOps if you want him on threads for the actual allowlist (tom.patel@finledger.com). We'll aim to send the preliminary CIDRs by EOD and the formal allowlist after the security review (likely Monday).

– Alex Ramos
Senior Solutions Engineer, FinLedger
alex.ramos@finledger.com
Phone: +1 (212) 555-8421

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@finledger.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jul 2028 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC staging handshake - network ownership clarifications

Alex —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from Redwood's ops/security side so NetOps has everything to hand: 

1) Mutual TLS: Redwood supports both TLS termination at the customer endpoint and mutual TLS. If you terminate TLS at FinLedger, we'll present a client cert for the connector (mutual TLS) or we can send over the traffic over an encrypted PrivateLink without client certs if you prefer. Please tell us the preferred mode and the cert format (PEM/PKCS12).

2) Egress behavior: since you mentioned FinLedger will provide static NAT IPs, that's ideal — it lets us avoid routing back to public internet for callbacks. When you share the CIDRs, please indicate whether they are for inbound allowlist on your PrivateLink interface only, or if we should expect the same egress IPs for callbacks to your telemetry endpoints.

3) Firewall port list: minimal ports required are 443 (HTTPS) + 10250 (internal telemetry port) — if your security team needs a formal list we can provide a one-page port/endpoint matrix.

4) SOW and cutover timeline: we can lock the SOW after we receive the allowlist and your confirmation on TLS mode. We can then schedule a 4-hour staging window for validation; propose Fri 7/28 01:00–05:00 UTC.

Attaching the network sketch (network-diagram-v1.pdf) and the draft SOW again for convenience.

Neha Kapoor
Principal Cloud Ops
Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 15 Jul 2028 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC staging handshake - network ownership clarifications

Alex / team —

Quick confirmation from engineering: Redwood can support both models. Recommended default for fastest onboarding is:

- PrivateLink to FinLedger endpoint (customer-managed TLS termination).
- FinLedger provides static egress NAT IPs for the connector (preferred).
- If FinLedger wants Redwood to terminate TLS, we can provide mutual TLS and rotate client certs on a monthly or quarterly cadence; that adds an extra ops step on our side and small SOW delta.

Action items we will take now: 
- I'll update the SOW to include both options (customer-terminate and Redwood-terminate) with a redline for the cert/rotation responsibilities.
- Neha will prepare the port/endpoint matrix.

Alex — please send Tom from NetOps on the thread (tom.patel@finledger.com) or share the preliminary CIDRs. We'll aim to lock the SOW and confirm the staging window by Monday.

Thanks —

Ben Carter
Network Reliability Lead
Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0042
